about: Draws the control that names what is being worked in and opens the list of what else could be.

head.about: At the head of a sidebar, the row the width of the column. Press it and the list opens as wide as the row: the workspaces, one of them suspended, then a rule and what else there is to do.
head.title: At the head of a sidebar

placement.about: Where the control is placed, which decides how wide it is. At the head of a sidebar it is a row the width of the column, so the name and the detail have the column to read in. Anywhere else it takes the width of its words and the detail is dropped: the catalogue’s own bar draws three of these in a toolbar.
placement.title: Placements

title: Switcher

variant.about: Every look at every size. Press a control and the list opens beneath it.
variant.title: Looks and sizes
